verses.text: T'a yuktakil ab'il tzeyaktan he k'anan meltzaj he tastak ayb'at majanil.
Ha jun tik, icha tik yaji: Masanil mach to ay tas ix yak' majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manhxookab' sk'anb'ej, yujto a jun ab'il chi' ix yal Jehová to maxtzak yal-laj sk'anb'ajxi tas ayb'at majanil.
Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il syal he k'anb'anxi tas ix eyak' majanil chi'. Haxo pax t'a junok ketchonhab' jun, manhxo he k'anb'ej.
Tato ol he k'ulej icha chi', malaj mach ol b'at mheb'ail t'a yib'anh t'a he kal, yujto ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh t'a lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Tato ol he k'anab'ajej he b'eyb'alan juntzanh cheknab'il wan walankan tik t'ayex,

ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti', tzijtum tas ol yal eyak'an majanil t'a juntzanhxo nakión. Palta a ex tik, manhok exlaj ol he k'an tastak he majnej t'a heb'. Tzijtum juntzanh nakión ol eyak' yajalil t'a yib'anh, palta manhoklaj heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh.
Tato ay junok heb' ketchonhab' tik meb'a' t'a he kal t'a junok chonhab' wan yak'an Jehová t'ayex, manh chukok tzeyutej he k'ol t'a heb', palta tze kol heb' t'a tas tz'och yuj,
tze sian tastak t'a heb', tzeyak'an smajnej heb' tastak tz'och yuj.

Tzeya ilej he pensar, xe natalaj icha tik: Manhxo ol wak'laj tas majanil, ina to lak'anxo sjawi yukil ab'il, haton jun ab'il b'aj maxtzak k'anb'aj tastak ayb'at majanil, xe chitalaj. Max yal to chuk tzeyutej he k'ol t'a heb' meb'a' ay t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', k'etalaj yaw heb' t'a Jehová yuj he chukk'olal chi', yuj chi' tz'och he mul t'a Jehová.
Mokab' chukok tzeyab'i tzex kolwaj t'a heb', b'ekanokab' yel eyuuj, yujto a yuj tas wach' tze k'ulej chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Aynhej heb' meb'a' t'a he kal, yuj chi' a in swal t'ayex to elb'enokab' eyuuj t'a heb' ketchonhab' wan yab'an syail mheb'ail t'a yol he chonhab' chi'.
Tato ay junok heb' ketisraelal, junok winak, ma junok ix ix schonhji t'ayex tz'och chekab'ok, wakenhej ab'il tz'och he chekab'ok, haxo t'a yukil ab'il jun, tzeyak'anel t'a libre.
Ayik tz'el t'a libre chi', max el-laj t'a ichnhej ta'.
Palta niwanokab' tas tzeyak' t'ay: Nok' kalnel yet' ixim trigo yet' wino. Syalelk'ochi to syik'pax yik t'a masanil tas ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyuuj to onh ek'pax chekab'wumal t'a Egipto, palta a Jehová ko Diosal onh kolanelta. Yuj chi' syak' jun cheknab'il tik t'ayex tiknaik.
Palta tato a junok heb' he chekab' chi' max yal-laj sk'ol tz'el t'a libre, yujto xajan ex yuj heb' yet' eyaleyuninal, yujto wach' yajek' heb' heyet'ok,

tato icha chi', tzeyik'kot junok k'een ol-lab' tzeyak'anoch chek'an heb' t'a spuertail he pat, tzeyolan schikin heb' yet' k'een. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan heb' he chekab'ok t'a junelnhej. Icha pax chi' tz'utaj heb' ix ix tz'ochkan chekab'ok t'a junelnhej.

Mokab' chukok tzeyab'i ayik tzeyak'anel heb' he chekab' chi' t'a libre, yujto wake' ab'il ix ex yak' serwil heb', nanhalnhej tze tup heb' t'a stojol junok mach tz'akan scha stojol t'a junok k'u. Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej.

Masanil sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax, ma nok' he kalnel, tato winak tze sik'kaneli yik tz'ochkan yikok Jehová ko Diosal. Manh eyak' munlaj nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax chi', manh he joxpaxel xil nok' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel chi'.
Junjunnhej ab'il tze chi'an nok' yet' eyal eyuninal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, t'a jun lugar ol sik'el skajnub'ok.
Palta tato ay jab'ok spaltail nok' jun, tato koxo yok nok', mato chuklaj yol sat nok', ma manh wal wach'ok nok', manh eyak' nok' silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ha nok' chi', syal he chi'an nok' b'aj kajan ex chi'. Yalnhej mach syal schi'an nok', taxonhej wach' yaj heb', icha yalan ley, mato maay, ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an nok' k'ultakil chej, ma nok' ch'ukul.
Palta manh he chi' schiq'uil nok', anhej to tze tob'el t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'aj stob'kanb'at ha ha'.
